pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: join ANC visits and livelihoods by district and year, 2023 ANC and employment rates side by side
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: WITH anc_rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) AS anc_rate FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2023), livelihood_rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * employed_at_6_months / NULLIF(NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0), 0) AS employment_rate FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023) SELECT a.district, a.year, a.anc_rate, l.employment_rate FROM anc_rates AS a JOIN livelihood_rates AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year

attempts.response:
WITH anc_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    district,
    year,
    100.0 * anc4_completed / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS anc_rate
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE year = 2023
),
livelihood_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    district,
    year,
    100.0 * employed_at_6_months / NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0) AS employment_rate
  FROM livelihoods
  WHERE year = 2023
)
SELECT 
  a.district,
  a.year,
  a.anc_rate,
  l.employment_rate
FROM anc_rates a
JOIN livelihood_rates l
  ON a.district = l.district
  AND a.year = l.year;
